Het appmenu van thematiq vervangt het st: The thematiq apps menu replaces the default menu: apps with a payoff, pinning to the top bar, Create and a personal order. This is the default for everyone; everyone then adjusts their own order and pinned apps.
Aan of uit, meer keuze is er niet. Uit:: On or off, there is no further choice. Off: Nextcloud keeps its own menu, the rest of the house style stays.
